patch.value: Investigate native GitHub check waits that remain active after terminal checks

Observed during PR1515: the native gh2.102.0 check watcher remained alive after a fresh head snapshot showed39successful checks and3skips. Its process was25minutes old. Interrupting only the read-only watcher and starting the reviews phase returned immediately with the accurate unresolved-conversation blocker. No CI job or required status was bypassed. Upstream cause and controlled reproduction remain unconfirmed.

Reproduce or explicitly attribute the stalled native watcher using terminal and genuinely pending controls; define bounded liveness behavior without certifying readiness from timeout or unavailable data; retain exact-head required publisher and conversation evidence; preserve the completed predecessor scope and record any upstream CLI issue.
A stuck transport wait is distinguishable from pending hosted work and never becomes a false successful review receipt.
